canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 9,916 FHA applications American Pacific Mortgage Corporation acted on ended without a credit decision: 16.7% withdrawn by the applicant and 0.6% closed for incompleteness.

required_qualifiers.population: American Pacific Mortgage Corporation FHA applications acted on (actions 1-5: originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, closed for incompleteness; purchased loans and preapproval requests excluded; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate; process, market, applicant pool and reporting practice are not separable in the record

does_not_establish: that American Pacific Mortgage Corporation's process causes applicants to withdraw, or that its applicants cause files to close
that American Pacific Mortgage Corporation is better or worse than another lender for a given applicant
American Pacific Mortgage Corporation discriminates or violates law
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
